title: A House for the Night
text: Max is playing Minecraft with his friend Leo.
They have only one day to build a house.
Leo cuts trees, and Max finds stones.
When the sun goes down, the house isn't ready.
A big green creeper comes out of the dark forest.
Leo runs behind the house, but Max doesn't see the creeper.
Boom! Now they have a house with no walls.
